findings.description: The separator condition in get_help_spec is inverted: it now uses "; " when no prefix is a slash and " / " when one is, the reverse of the original code.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any Option whose prefixes include a slash (e.g. /debug/--no-debug or a '/' prefix) with any_prefix_is_slash set. Mechanism: the ternary was changed to `not any_prefix_is_slash`, so the slash-style separator is applied to non-slash options and "; " to slash options. Impact: --help output for such options shows the wrong spelling separators, a visible regression in the help text.
